subject: Initialize child process pipe file descriptor to -1 (#1911)
reason: The change initializes two local file descriptors in rdbSaveToReplicasSockets (src/rdb.c) to -1 instead of 0. Both variables are used only inside !dual_channel-guarded blocks, and on every !dual_channel path (including both anetPipe error paths) they are assigned real pipe fds before any close/read/use; on the dual_channel path they are never used at all. The old 0 initializer was therefore never closed or read on any reachable path, so this is purely defensive hardening with no observable behaviour change — no scenario can distinguish the two builds.
